svg.title: BC Parks flag — semicircle
svg.desc: Canonical shared geometry with a caption/palette edition. The whole master is aligned to the source crop, never individual borders or crests. Outlined type retains its natural glyph proportions; fitting uniformly reduces cap size. Fine embroidery, exact typeface and calibrated colours remain approximate. Wording and flag: BC Parks flag badge as PofBC draws it (frame, flag and outlined BC / Parks), in the atlas’s thread colours.
